title: cert-manager LoopRuntime wrapper values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on LoopRuntime-specific cert-manager hardening invariants. INF-G08 + ADR D7 hardened pod security context defaults uniformly across pod-bearing charts; regression to root/privileged would fail VAP requireResourceLimits + requirePodSecurityStandard. Schema enforces non-root + capability drop + read-only root FS at lint time.

limits.description: CPU + memory limits MUST be set (VAP requireResourceLimits).

requests.description: CPU + memory requests MUST be set (VAP requireResourceLimits).

runAsNonRoot.description: LoopRuntime invariant INF-G08: MUST be true. Setting to false would let cert-manager controller run as root in cert-manager namespace. Schema rejects false at lint.

type.description: Seccomp profile type. 'RuntimeDefault' = recommended. 'Unconfined' explicitly rejected (would weaken syscall isolation).

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: LoopRuntime INF-G08: read-only root FS MUST be enforced. False would allow controller to write arbitrary paths (cred-stealing risk).

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: LoopRuntime INF-G08: privilege escalation MUST be forbidden.

drop.description: MUST contain 'ALL' (drops every Linux capability). Partial drop list = weakness.

installCRDs.description: Whether the chart installs cert-manager CRDs. Default: true. If false, CRDs must be pre-installed via separate step (operator decision).
